body: 3. General Investment Strategies for 2026 — Adapting Your Portfolio for a Changing Market. ## General Investment Considerations for 2026 — Adapting Portfolios for a Changing Market. The global economy is entering 2026 with a combination of opportunities and uncertainties. Economic conditions are influenced by higher interest rates, shifting market dynamics, changes in trade policy, geopolitical developments in regions such as the Middle East, and new legislation affecting businesses and financial markets. At the same time, advancements in artificial intelligence, moderate economic growth in several regions, and evolving labour-market trends may impact various sectors. Understanding economic and financial factors, as well as characteristics of different asset classes, can provide context for interpreting market activity. This article examines investing in 2026 by reviewing the factors influencing markets and highlighting potential developments across equities, fixed income, and alternative investments. ## The 2026 Macro Backdrop: Implications for the Global Economy.
